model.complex: Existing provisional C/S/H allelic locus, unchanged inheritance and viability. Sable and Highway are not extra independent genes.
model.veil: Six game-only inherited modifier pairs; active on heterozygous Lilly, carried silently by non-Lilly animals. Cosmetic overrides are not inherited.
model.limits: Adult material expression on the same native silhouette. No raised scales, ageing, medical prediction or invented survival probabilities.
